title: RIDSECT Aerosol 270ml
description:
RIDSECT Aerosol 270ml
RIDSECT Aerosol is equipped with powerful nozzle spray cap that provides effective mosquitoes protection.

• New and improved formula.
• Easy to use.
• Proven effectiveness.
• Kills mosquitoes effectively, even in those hidden areas.
• Available in 270ml size.
• Good quality and value for money.

How to use:
• Switch on the lights before use. Close all doors and windows. Spray Ridsect upwards throughout the room for about 2 – 3 seconds. After spraying, leave the room and keep the doors and windows closed for at least 10 min before re-enter. Ensure the room is properly ventilated upon entering.

Safety:
• Read the label before use.

• Read the label before use.
